```suggestion
	String current_embedded_window;
```
Unnecessary default
Unrelated, please restore this change hurts readability
Forward declare these
Using `p_parent` here only make sense for Window where native parent window handle can be used, so probably should be named in a more generic manner (e.g, `p_embedding_id`).
I would use something more unique, like node path (`get_path()`) to identify windows (title still can be shown in the user facing UI).

Same here, instead of using a title which is not unique, it's probably better to use `SetWindowLongW()` and store the unique ID in extra window data (which can be the same ID used as `p_parent/p_embedding_id` in `create_window`).

I like the idea of using something more unique under the hood, but how would the user be able to know what node path their window will be at when the game is built? Right now the title is something you type in to the UI to tell the game tab to add to the `--swid` parameter passed to the built game. When I was explaining this approach in [the proposal](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11091), @Hilderin seemed to say it was okay for the title to be used as the identifier, and for it to work in situations where the user spawns in a window at runtime on frame 1, we don't have an available list of windows to choose from. That's why typing in the title seemed to be the best approach for now.

I think it would be good to have a more convenient selector, but we'd lose that ability for arbitrary code-spawned windows to be embedded, and searching through all scenes for possible windows seems like... a lot to do when the PR is already huge haha. If this is what you're talking about here, would it be alright to leave that as an interface improvement for later while we figure out a good approach?

Secondary option if we really must have this: is there some other unique value that is also user-facing for each window that could be easily read and checked from the code? If not, would it make sense to make it? Like a "Window ID" field that is intended to be unique but not shown visually on the window like the title is?
I guess it is fine for the most cases.
